name: video_resize
description: Resize a video or change its shape. Give width and/or height to scale, or an aspect ratio such as 9:16 (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9. fit decides how the picture fills the new shape: pad (letterbox, default), crop (fill and cut the edges; focus picks which part to keep), blur (fill the bars with a blurred copy, popular for vertical video) or stretch.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

width.description: Target width in pixels. With only width or height, the other follows the aspect ratio.

aspect.description: Target aspect ratio such as 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 or 21:9. Without width/height the size is derived from the source.

focus.description: With fit crop: which part to keep. Default center.

pad_color.description: Bar color for fit pad: a name (black, white) or hex (0x1E1E1E). Default black.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_<width>x<height>.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
